messages: Welcome back, Eval6972f88b0e144e06 the Minotaur Berserker.
Game seed: 4 (custom seed)
Trog says: Kill them all!
Press ? for a list of commands and other information.
Okay, then.
You feel sick. The bat barely misses you.
You feel sick. The bat attacks as it pursues you!
The bat hits you but does no damage. The bat closely misses you.
There is an open door here.
Things that are here:
a dart slug corpse; a frilled lizard corpse
You feel sick.
You are no longer poisoned.
The bat barely misses you. The bat hits you but does no damage.
The bat attacks as it pursues you! The bat hits you but does no damage. x2
You hit the bat.
You kill the bat!
Trog accepts your kill.
You barely miss the hobgoblin. You headbutt the hobgoblin.
The hobgoblin is severely wounded.
The hobgoblin hits you but does no damage.
You hit the hobgoblin but do no damage.
The hobgoblin is severely wounded.
The hobgoblin completely misses you. You furiously retaliate!
You headbutt the hobgoblin.
You kill the hobgoblin!
Trog accepts your kill.
You hit the ribbon worm but do no damage.
Your headbutt misses the ribbon worm. The ribbon worm bites you.
